description: Declared rules that assign required evidence categories to plan obligations. A rule applies to an obligation when every condition it states holds (conditions: rules = verification rule ids from verification-rules.json, gates, documents, requirements = selector grammar of Model.matches, titlePattern = .NET regex over the requirement title, obligationKinds, obligations = exact baseline obligation ids, freshnessPolicies = the requirement's plan policy); within one condition any listed value matches. Every applicable rule contributes its category; the union is the obligation's required set. An obligation no rule reaches is reported 'unclassified' missing coverage, never assigned a default. Each rule cites the declared requirement data it rests on (source), so a reviewer can check it without reading code. Categories also state their evidence class (application-test, reviewer, process, owner) and the producer expected to create the evidence; process and owner categories are proven by run records and owner attestations (verify-process), never by an application test.

categories.definition: Deterministic tests of one component in isolation (F# unit and property tests, illegal-transition and forged-history variants); no browser, provider or network.
categories.producer: test run of the application (Dokimos / CI test job)

categories.definition: Tests across a boundary between components or systems: producer/consumer contract tests, recorded-response provider contract tests, storage golden replay, dependency compatibility smoke, catalog verification.
categories.producer: test run of the application (Dokimos / CI test job)

categories.definition: The application exercised in a real browser engine (WebKit/Chromium via Percepta or Playwright), offline-fixture or deployed, including printed and rendered output.
categories.producer: browser test run (Percepta / Playwright in CI)

categories.definition: Real requests against the authorized live provider (the GitHub test repository) in the candidate's own run, with independent re-reads; mocked or recorded responses never count.
categories.producer: live provider test run in the candidate's own CI run

categories.definition: Evidence that a security property holds: credential handling, least privilege, secret non-disclosure in logs, URLs, screenshots and artifacts.
categories.producer: security test run or security review record

categories.definition: Accessibility verification: automated accessibility report (axe), keyboard-only and focus checks, reduced motion, screen-reader semantics.
categories.producer: accessibility test run or accessibility review record

categories.definition: Evidence produced by a party independent of the implementing agent: an independent reviewer's record, or an acceptance job the implementer does not author, bound to the reviewed or deployed SHA.
categories.producer: independent reviewer record (Praxis work evidence --kind independent-review) or an acceptance job the implementer does not author

categories.definition: A record of how the work was carried out, written while it happened to the run's Praxis event log: assignment, execution start, checkpoints, dependency decisions, scope changes, release-candidate selection, test-result and acceptance references. A record the tooling observed (a verified checkpoint, CI automation) or a statement an agent made, bound to the candidate; never a reviewer finding or an owner decision.
categories.producer: Praxis work event log of the rehearsal repository (work start, work checkpoint, work evidence)

categories.definition: A decision that only the owner or an authorized human may make, recorded by that human and backed by an attestation the verifier checks against the frozen rules (for example a pull-request review by the owner's login, fetched by CI). A decision an agent transcribed is an agent assertion and never counts.
categories.producer: owner-approval records in the Praxis work event log, with CI-observed attestations

baseline requirement titles that name security or credentials (at aab8f80: AR-014 "Secure capability isolation", PF-015 "Credentials and security"); no verification rule declares a security method, so the title is the declared data used

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): AR-005-O1 "Before designing a component, discover existing Echelon capabilities, owners, supported versions, and contracts."; AR-005-O2 "Reuse verified implementations; require an explicit approved justification for duplication."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): AR-012-O1 "Agent changes must be bounded to named requirements and paths; commits should stage intended files only."; AR-012-O2 "Detect unrelated changes and require explicit review before inclusion."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): AR-015-O1 "Maintain durable, compact, machine-readable checkpoints of objectives, decisions, completed work, open defects, evidence, and next actions so agent restarts do not re-decide settled questions."; AR-021-O1 "Prefer one long-running implementation agent with compact durable checkpoints."; AR-021-O2 "Do not require structured handoffs by default."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): AR-017-O1 "Route implementation work to the actual owning repository through its documented Praxis input folder and accepted grammar, never GitHub Issues."; AR-017-O2 "Do not assume component ownership from its name."; UI-021-O3 "Preserve traceability and approved-scope handling in Praxis."; UI-040-O2 "Trace all requirements through the documented Praxis input process; record approved exclusions explicitly."; VER-010-O1 "Every future rehearsal must reconcile VER-001..VER-010 with implementation and tests or an explicitly approved exclusion."; VER-010-O2 "Work items must go through each owning repository's documented Praxis input path, not GitHub Issues."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): VER-001-O1 "Each build MUST use the newest available stable, published, compatible release of every applicable Echelon system at the time the build baseline is locked."; VER-001-O2 "Applicable systems include Praxis, Ordo, Dokimos, Percepta, Forma, Forma Studio/workflow layout, Limen, Folio, and any actually integrated Echelon dependencies."; VER-001-O3 "Discover the real owner and release channel for each; do not invent a release or assume every system is a runtime dependency."; VER-002-O1 "Query authoritative package registries, GitHub releases/tags, or the owning repository's documented release source immediately before baseline lock."; VER-002-O2 "Record checked timestamp, candidate release, source reference, and why it was selected."; VER-002-O3 "Do not equate latest main commit with latest released artifact."; VER-003-O1 "Prefer latest stable only when integration contracts and acceptance tests pass."; VER-003-O2 "If the newest release is incompatible, fail the upgrade gate or obtain a documented, authorized exception for the newest known compatible release."; VER-004-O3 "Re-resolve latest versions for each new rehearsal or explicitly authorized refresh."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): AR-021-O3 "Measure correctness and requirement retention after context compaction; use independent reviewers at release candidates."; UI-030-O3 "Record source requirement IDs, tests, exact deployed SHA, and independent review."

baseline obligation text (process, not product behaviour): PF-019-O1 "During development, agents should run the smallest relevant deterministic tests first, batch integration checks at meaningful checkpoints, and run the complete live/deployed suite before release."

baseline obligation text (a decision only an authorized human makes): AR-024-O1 "An authorized human must resolve the write scope, Percepta release/waiver, DF-CAUSA-2026-0003 operator decisions, and frozen requirements/stack before a timed full-write rehearsal."; AR-024-O2 "Agents must not self-ratify these decisions."; AR-008-O2 "Reviewers cannot self-ratify operator decisions."

baseline obligation text at 856157a (AR-027..AR-035, added for Rehearsal 6 by DEC-R6-005; the text requires a start in a real browser): AR-029-O1 "Every change to the application MUST show, in CI, that both the production and test builds start in a real browser on every primary route with no runtime or interpreter fault."

baseline obligation text at 856157a (AR-027..AR-035, added for Rehearsal 6 by DEC-R6-005; the text requires CI proof that the production artifact exposes no test control): AR-030-O1 "Test-only hooks, state injection, fixture modes and their exports MUST be compiled out of the production build, not merely disabled."; AR-030-O2 "CI MUST prove the production artifact contains none of them and that neither page globals nor runtime exports can enable them."

baseline obligation text at 856157a (AR-027..AR-035, added for Rehearsal 6 by DEC-R6-005; the text requires persistence proven across writers): AR-035-O1 "Persistence MUST be proven under concurrent writers: several tabs, devices and page loads, with lost answers and reloads."; AR-035-O2 "Write markers MUST be unique across writers, and a save MUST NOT count as confirmed until the committed content has been read back and verified."; AR-035-O3 "After a write is sent, any answer the code does not recognise MUST be treated as "may have saved", never as "not written"."; AR-035-O4 "Device-local durable state MUST survive several tabs sharing one store."

notCategorized.reason: the ledger row is the carrier of claims, not evidence of an obligation
requirements preservation proves the derivation, not the implementation of an obligation
process records (Praxis work items, checkpoints) match none of the seven categories; an obligation reached only by VR-PROCESS is reported unclassified
